evidence: As shown in Fig. 1 (a), tris(dimethylamino)antimony (TDMASb), di-tert-butyl telluride (Te(t-Bu) 2), and bis(trimetylsilyl)selenide (Se(SiMe 3)2) were used as precursors of Sb, Te, and Se, respectively. The precursor canisters of Sb, Te, and Se were maintained at 35, 45, and 60 °C for vapor suction, respectively. Argon gas was used as the carrier gas for each precursor at a flow rate of 50 standard cubic centimeters per minute (sccm), and H2 and NH 3 gases were used as the reactant gases at a flow rate of 50 sccm.
